decks.notes: The deck focuses on using the powerful Oath of Druids enchantment to cheat out big creatures like Minsc & Boo, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Narset, Parter of Veils. It also includes a variety of control elements like Force of Will, Pyroblast, and Lightning Bolt to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells and removal while setting up a powerful win condition with Oath of Druids. The presence of cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Wrenn and Six adds versatility and additional disruption to the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize powerful artifact cards and disruptive land destruction to slow down the opponent and control the game. By using cards like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere, along with Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb for mana acceleration, this deck can quickly get ahead of the opponent. Golos, Tireless Pilgrim allows for consistent land drops, while Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland disrupt the opponent's mana base. Nettlecyst and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional threats, with the ability to close out the game quickly with Time Vault and Manifold Key combo.

This deck focuses on fast, efficient plays and disruption to overwhelm opponents in the early game. By utilizing powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk, along with cheap disruptive counterspells like Mental Misstep and Pyroblast, it aims to control the board while generating card advantage. Creatures like Dreadhorde Arcanist and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional threats and card advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to all three colors, allowing for flexibility in casting your spells and maintaining tempo advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while using fast mana and card advantage to establish a strong board presence. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, while also utilizing powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Bolas's Citadel to generate card advantage and create explosive turns. By combining disruptive elements with efficient threats like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Hullbreacher, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly getting creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One onto the battlefield by using Bazaar of Baghdad to fill the graveyard with cards. It also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect its creatures or disrupt opponents' game plans. The use of Squee, Goblin Nabob allows for constant recursion of creatures from the graveyard, providing a steady stream of threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and quickly overwhelm opponents with its aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly controlling the game by disrupting opponent's plans with counterspells and hatebears while applying pressure with efficient creatures. The strategy involves using disruptive creatures like Lavinia and Collector Ouphe to slow down opponents, complemented by counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect key cards. The deck aims to establish an early advantage through card advantage with Ancestral Recall and card selection with Ponder and Brainstorm, while also having access to powerful sideboard options like Prismatic Ending for versatile removal.

The deck revolves around fast mana acceleration, artifact synergy, and the ability to generate large amounts of card advantage. By utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Coveted Jewel, the deck can quickly draw through its library and assemble game-winning combos. The inclusion of cards such as Tinker, Time Vault, and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional avenues for victory. The deck aims to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelming advantage to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo with cards like Brain Freeze and Hullbreacher to quickly assemble a winning condition. It also includes classic Vintage staples like Black Lotus, Ancestral Recall, and Time Vault to accelerate the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells like Force of Will and Pyroblast while setting up its combo pieces for a quick and decisive victory. The inclusion of cards like Tinker and Tolarian Academy adds additional flexibility and power to the strategy, making it a formidable force in the format.

The deck focuses on efficiently assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game in a single turn. Through card manipulation like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain, along with disruption spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, the deck aims to set up a winning pile of cards with Doomsday. Key combo pieces such as Thassa's Oracle and Demonic Consultation are included to ensure a quick and decisive victory. The deck also includes powerful cards like Black Lotus, Time Walk, and Ancestral Recall to generate additional advantage and resources to secure the win.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and various tutors to assemble a winning combo quickly and efficiently. It aims to set up a situation where the player can stack their deck in a specific order, leading to a game-winning sequence of plays. The inclusion of countermagic and disruption spells like Force of Will and Duress helps protect the combo and ensure it goes off successfully. The deck's strategy revolves around quickly finding and resolving the Doomsday combo to win the game.

This deck focuses on using powerful spells to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and tutors, the deck aims to efficiently answer threats while setting up its own win condition. The inclusion of powerful mana artifacts like the Moxen and Black Lotus allows for explosive starts and the ability to cast multiple spells in a single turn. Tinkering for key artifacts like Time Vault or Bolas's Citadel can quickly shift the game in the control player's favor, leading to a victory through card advantage or combo finish.

This deck aims to generate a lot of mana quickly using cards like Ancient Tomb, Grim Monolith, and Mishra's Workshop in order to cast powerful spells like Tinker, Trinisphere, and Force of Will. The key concept of this deck is to assemble the combo pieces Coveted Jewel and Paradoxical Outcome to generate a massive advantage in card advantage and mana, allowing the player to overwhelm their opponent and win the game quickly. This combo is further supported by cards like Mana Crypt, Gitaxian Probe, and Mystic Forge, allowing for a streamlined and efficient win condition.

The main concept of this deck is to abuse the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures and then bring them back onto the battlefield through various interactions like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. By utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to manipulate the graveyard, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flood of creatures and potentially win the game in a single explosive turn. With powerful disruptive spells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap, the deck aims to protect its game-winning combo from being disrupted.

This Vintage deck focuses on utilizing hatebears and aggro strategies to disrupt opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them. The deck includes powerful hate cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down opponents, while efficient creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Solitude provide a fast clock. Emeria's Call and Loran of the Third Path offer additional value and late-game options. The mana base is streamlined with fast mana rocks and disruptive lands like Cavern of Souls and Wasteland to support the aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while using Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play. Show and Tell can also be used to put these threats into play early. The deck also includes various tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find key cards, along with powerful artifact ramp like Black Lotus and Moxen. The inclusion of Time Vault combo with Voltaic Key provides an alternative win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Mishra's Workshop to power out powerful artifacts like Coveted Jewel, which can generate a large amount of card advantage and mana acceleration. The deck also includes key combo pieces like Time Vault and Voltaic Key to potentially take extra turns. With cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Urza's Saga to search for important pieces, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.
